description: Query the AOP-Wiki XML export — Adverse Outcome Pathways, Key Events, and Key Event Relationships — through the installable aop-wiki-cli module. Use when asked to find the AOP/KE/KER for a mechanism, stressor, or adverse outcome; to run or write an AOP-Wiki term search config; to pull KER weight-of-evidence, empirical support, or evidence tables; to get event completion/integration rankings; or to refresh the AOP-Wiki XML snapshot.
